test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

The royal messengers ______ out last night.
solution:
The correct answer is **"went."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Went"** is the past tense of the verb **"go"**, which is the appropriate verb to use in this context.
 
• The presence of the phrase **"last night"** shows that the sentence is in the past tense.
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, indicating that the action has already occurred.
 
• The past tense form (V2 form) of the verb** "go"** is **"went."**
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The royal messengers **went**__ out last night. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1,** "goes"**, is incorrect because it is present tense and does not match the tense of the sentence.
 
• Option 2, **"go",** is incorrect because it is singular and does not match the plural subject of the sentence.
 
• Option 3, **"gone"**, is incorrect because it is a past participle and requires an auxiliary verb (e.g. "have gone") to form the past tense.
